from PIL import Image,ImageDraw
cap=cv2.VideoCapture('renders/robot_arm_pov.mp4')
canvas=Image.new('RGB',(1280,760),'#14201e')
for i,t in enumerate([0,6,8.7,14.9]):
 cap.set(cv2.CAP_PROP_POS_MSEC,t*1000)
 ok,frame=cap.read()
 if not ok: raise RuntimeError(f'Cannot read frame at {t}')
 im=Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(frame,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)).resize((640,360))
 x=(i%2)*640;y=(i//2)*380
 canvas.paste(im,(x,y))
 ImageDraw.Draw(canvas).text((x+12,y+363),f'{t:.1f} s',fill='#d8efdf')
canvas.save('renders/contact_sheet.jpg',quality=90)
print('Four output frames decoded and contact sheet saved.')
